title: Verify zero cross-agent mixing and 100% individual + team coverage on every audit
context_summary: 32 agents across 11 teams maintain separate individual JSONL ledgers and curated team JSON files.
observation: Accidental writes to the wrong agent file or duplicate keys silently corrupt future LLM retrieval.
verified_action: Audit every individual JSONL and team JSON file for agent_id/team_id purity, zero duplicate keys, zero secrets, and 100% roster coverage.
